description: Submission of details of samples of all materials to be used on the external faces of the building, including walls, roof coverings, windows and doors pursuant to condition 3;  samples of surface materials, of the soft and hard landscaping of all private and communal external areas, including planting, planting schedules, paving, boundary walls, fences, gates and other means of enclosure pursuant to condition 4; Secured by Design pursuant to condition 5; green roof and green wall system pursuant to condition 10; siting, gradient and number of Solar PV Panels as shown on Dwg Nos. 2199-PDP-XX-XX-DR-A-02001 Rev P01 & 2199-PDP-XX-XX-DR-A-02100 Rev P01, to be installed on the roofs and details of the Ground Source Heat Pumps as stated within the Energy Statement prepared by Phillips Buckell Ltd  (Document Ref: 24010.7.Energy Rev P1, dated March 2024) pursuant to condition 11; revised Sustainable Drainage Strategy pursuant to condition 13; demolition management plan and a demolition logistics plan pursuant to condition 15; construction management plan and a construction logistics plan pursuant to condition 16; Air Quality Dust Management Plan (Demo) pursuant to condition 17; Air Quality Dust Management Plan (Const) pursuant to condition 18; Ventilation Strategy Report to mitigate the impact of existing poor air quality for the eight self-contained dwellinghouses (Use Class C3) pursuant to condition 20; preliminary risk assessment pursuant to condition 26; site investigation scheme pursuant to condition 27; quantitative risk assessment report pursuant to condition 28; remediation method statement pursuant to condition 29; verification report pursuant to condition 30; onward long-term monitoring methodology report pursuant to condition 31 of planning permission ref: 2024/00747/FUL granted 6th March 2025.
borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
